description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and managing GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnels and associated network setup, particularly for hotspot and VPN functionalities. It includes functions for creating/destroying tunnels, handling system events, configuring network bridges, and controlling WiFi SSIDs in a network device environment.

methods.name: wait_for_erouter0_ready
methods.description: Waits for the wan-status to be 'started', indicating erouter0 is ready.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to snooping based on certain flags.

methods.name: read_greInst
methods.description: Reads GRE interface instance configuration from PSM and associated SSID information.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates a GRE tunnel with specified remote endpoint and interface name.

methods.name: destroy_tunnel
methods.description: Destroys the specified GRE tunnel interface.

methods.name: gre_preproc
methods.description: Prepares GRE interface instances by gathering info and setting system events.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events for keepalive parameters.

methods.name: bInst_to_bNames
methods.description: Converts bridge instance IDs to their associated names for internal tracking.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Reads initial GRE configuration parameters from PSM and system events.

methods.name: read_tunnel_params
methods.description: Reads tunnel parameters like keys and checksum flags for the given GRE instance.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Updates bridge configuration for a GRE interface, setting snooping rules and MSS.

methods.name: remove_bridge_config
methods.description: Removes bridge-related configuration rules for the specified interface and bridges.

methods.name: update_bridge_frag_config
methods.description: Sets fragmentation/mtu configurations for bridges in a GRE instance.

methods.name: get_ssids
methods.description: Retrieves SSID and radio instance information associated with a GRE instance.

methods.name: set_ssids_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables SSIDs associated with a GRE instance, applying necessary settings.

methods.name: set_apisolation
methods.description: Enables client isolation on all SSIDs of a GRE instance.

methods.name: kick_clients
methods.description: Kicks associated clients from WiFi SSIDs for the specified GRE instance.

methods.name: kill_procs
methods.description: Kills hotspot and ARP processing related processes for cleanup.

methods.name: hotspot_down
methods.description: Brings down a hotspot instance, including stopping processes and tearing down bridges.

methods.name: hotspot_up
methods.description: Brings up a hotspot instance, configuring bridges, SSIDs, and GRE tunnels.

methods.name: check_ssids
methods.description: Checks the status of SSIDs and manages enabling/disabling based on current system state.

methods.name: set_wecb_bridges
methods.description: Sets the WECB (Wireless Ethernet Bridge) bridge instances.
